notes.title: AdvertCity Version 9.8.9682.52935
notes.content:
A selection of updates and improvements to AdvertCity.

Changelog:
[list]
    [*]Improved text layout rules to prevent inadvertent wrapping of header titles.
    [*]Improved button layout to avoid wrapping megacorp names when the font is larger than default size.
    [*]Fixed a bug with progress bar accuracy when starting a new game.
    [*]Fixed a bug with buildings remaining selected after a game ends.
    [*]Fixed several packaging-related bugs on OS X.
    [*]Various optimisations and codebase improvements.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: AdvertCity Version 9.7.9595.52450
notes.content:
The latest version of AdvertCity includes a variety of bug fixes and optimisations, improving performance and reliability on all platforms.

Some of the biggest changes:

[list]
    [*]Significant improvements in world generation times, even on older machines.
    [*]Improved multi-threaded implementation of parts of the world generation code.
    [*]Improvements in font resizing, with UI elements fitting adjusted text sizes better.
    [*]Additional help, about and information menus, and menu links to the wiki and other helpful info.
    [*]Fixed volume adjustments being lost when starting a new game or loading one.
    [*]Fixed errors in water animation.
    [*]Fixing library dependencies on older Linux distributions.
[/list]

Additionally there are a variety of smaller bugfixes and optimisations throughout the code.  Enjoy!

tags.feature: [*]Additional help, about and information menus, and menu links to the wiki and other helpful info.

tags.bug: [*]Fixed volume adjustments being lost when starting a new game or loading one.
[*]Fixing library dependencies on older Linux distributions.

notes.title: AdvertCity Version 9.7.9557.52228
notes.content:
The latest version of AdvertCity, 9.7.9557.52228.

A series of small improvements and optimisations, mostly behind the scenes but with a few especially visible improvements:
[list]
    [*]World generation time reduced dramatically - generating a new city that previously took over 5 minutes on one of our test machines now runs in under 30 seconds.
    [*]Parallel processing used more during city and road layout, better use of multi-core processors.
    [*]Game logic performance optimisations throughout - lower system load during normal gameplay.
    [*]Improvements to mouse sensitivity menu options - separate horizontal and vertical sensitivity settings, edge-look sensitivity settings and edge-look border width setting.
    [*]New setting to toggle vsync on and off, which is now saved between game runs.
    [*]Optimisations and improvements to our vector maths library, which yields small speedup improvements to many aspects of the game.
    [*]A couple of typo fixes in building descriptions and menus.
[/list]

If you encounter any bugs, please remember to report them on our [url=http://code.voxelstorm.com/advertcity/issues/]issue tracker[/url] - and enjoy the game!

[*]Improvements to mouse sensitivity menu options - separate horizontal and vertical sensitivity settings, edge-look sensitivity settings and edge-look border width setting.

notes.title: AdvertCity Version 9.5.9337.51036
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that AdvertCity has been updated to version 9.5, with a variety of improvements thanks to your feedback!
[list]
    [*]New achievements, 64 in total - see where you stand on the full [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/365800/achievements/]global achievement statistics[/url]!
    [*]Game settings are now saved locally (independent from savegames, which are synced to Steam Cloud).
    [*]Option to hire maximum available employees for a given building.
    [*]Additional mouselook sensitivity settings.
    [*]Improved music volume control.
    [*]Miscellaneous bug fixes.
    [*]A variety of performance optimisations.
[/list]

Enjoy!
